method: Merge explicit reader receipts for each original occurrence, check gapless decoded-character coverage and full-scope completion, verify source integrity, and compare every ZIP member byte with its extracted occurrence. Hash equality, archive traversal, summaries, and assignment are not reading substitutes.
range_convention: Canonical intervals are zero-based, start-inclusive, end-exclusive coordinates in the original decoded text with CRLF preserved. Full-line receipts are mapped to those coordinates without losing the original line-ending span. A UTF-8 BOM is an encoding marker recorded by integrity metadata.
claim_limit: The audit checks consistency and completeness of the readers' explicit source-output receipts. It does not independently observe understanding and makes no gameplay, MCP, custom-role execution, or runtime validation claim.

readers.completion_scope_note: All retained assignment occurrences are fully read. source-0014 was explicitly reassigned to root and is not counted as this reader's own reading.
Reader B retained scope complete after root explicitly reassigned four whole unstarted occurrences. Whole original assignment is not claimed read by Reader B.
Complete remains false unless reader C personally reads all original assignments. Reader scope complete permits four explicit root delegations.
